niche.habitat: 2.8–3.5 km depth, stagnant high-brine porosity near 100–115°C
niche.diet: Microbial colonies, stored O2-burst attacks, mineral particulates
niche.active: Episodic, triggered by chemical gradients or pressure shifts

body: Spherical/ovoid, spiny exoskeleton, internal clathrate reservoirs

chains.trait: Internal methane clathrate reservoirs control buoyancy
links: Neutral buoyancy requires precise volume displacement
Calcium chloride saturation stabilizes heavy fluid

skill.effect: The creature rapidly releases gas from its bladders to shoot upward, leaving a trail of bubbles as it rises. It expends its stored energy to make the sudden ascent.

chains.weakness: Violent bubble release alerts prey and scavengers
observe: Rapid ascent leaves trailing ice crystals

journal.en: They carry their own ice to ride the dark.

plausibility.summary: Move the clathrate bladder into the shallow liquid shell (roughly the 0.9-1.2 km band where F21 allows it) or, if the predator must stay at 2.8-3.5 km, replace it with a compressible gas/lipid reservoir or regulated brine-density change. Keep the rapid-rise and noisy-release mechanic; drop the ice-chip secret at depth.

analogues.organism: Methane hydrate is stable in cold, high-pressure shallow sediments and in the upper few hundred metres of permafrost, not in hot deep crustal brines.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Radiolytic oxygen burst organs deliver one-shot attacks
links: Strict anaerobes cannot tolerate free O2 long-term
Radiolysis hoards H2 and O2 in same pore
Metabolic explosion poisons cell after one use

skill.effect: The creature violently expels a concentrated burst of oxygen that shocks nearby targets. It then falls still and spasms as its cells work to purge the toxic byproducts.

chains.weakness: Leaves them metabolically inactive until detox complete
observe: Gill slits vent pale vapor post-attack
Muscle fibers contract in violent spasms
Skin flushed red, then grey as O2 clears

plausibility.summary: Make the attack a concentrated oxidant/reactive-oxygen squirt that burns prey tissue and forces the host into detox afterwards; keep the silence-and-recovery weakness. Replace the boiling-brine image with a pale chemical plume, and keep the recharge tied to slow radiolytic accumulation.
fixes: Make the attack a concentrated oxidant/reactive-oxygen squirt that burns prey tissue and forces the host into detox afterwards; keep the silence-and-recovery weakness. Replace the boiling-brine image with a pale chemical plume, and keep the recharge tied to slow radiolytic accumulation.

links: Protein denaturation sets hard ceiling near 122°C

skill.effect: The creature braces its spiny carapace against the intense heat, shimmering as it absorbs the thermal energy. Its tough outer shell resists melting and holds its shape against the scorching environment.

chains.weakness: Carapace limits flexibility in narrow cracks
observe: Spines arranged in insulating air pockets
Metabolic rate drops as temperature rises

journal.en: They wear the crust’s fever as armor.

plausibility.summary: Keep the spines as defence/sensing, but move thermal tolerance into heat-shock proteins and thermostable biochemistry with a deliberately low metabolic rate; describe the near-ceiling torpor instead of thermal insulation.
fixes: Keep the spines as defence/sensing, but move thermal tolerance into heat-shock proteins and thermostable biochemistry with a deliberately low metabolic rate; describe the near-ceiling torpor instead of thermal insulation.

chains.trait: Seismic vibration receptors hunt via low-frequency tremors
links: Chemical diffusion moves scent only 1 cm/day
Sound travels 3000 m/s in solid rock
Fracture networks act as planetary acoustic waveguides

skill.effect: The creature tilts its head and listens to the ground, sensing faint tremors through its specialized receptors. Hidden movements nearby become apparent as it tracks the subtle vibrations.

chains.weakness: Deaf to high-frequency vibrations and sudden cracks
observe: Antennae quiver to distant tectonic shifts

journal.en: They listen to the world’s heartbeat.

plausibility.summary: No physics change needed: keep the skill and the high-frequency deafness. Replace the pupil-dilation cue with a whole-body freeze, a body-wall colour flush or a change in posture/antenna tension.
fixes: No physics change needed: keep the skill and the high-frequency deafness. Replace the pupil-dilation cue with a whole-body freeze, a body-wall colour flush or a change in posture/antenna tension.

secrets: If you cool their bladder with fresh ice chips, they become harmless and docile for a turn.
Their spines can be harvested to craft heat-resistant gear.
moments: When it strikes, the brine boils around it for three seconds, then goes still as the oxygen dies in its own veins.

journal.en: They are the planet’s sudden thought.
Warmth is a weapon, and a cage.
